13285.bio:
Michael (Mick) P. Judge is a seasoned family law attorney with nearly two decades of experience guiding individuals and families through life’s most complex transitions. In 2025, he joined the firm of Ligris to spearhead the launch of its Family Law Division, bringing his signature blend of strategic advocacy and compassionate counsel to this new and exciting chapter.

For over ten years, Mick has also served as an integral part of the Vesta organization, where his values align closely with Vesta’s mission of empowering individuals through divorce and beyond. He is deeply committed to client-centered advocacy, recognizing that legal challenges are not just technical matters but emotional journeys that require empathy and insight.

Known for his balanced approach—compassionate when needed, assertive when required—Mick is a trusted advocate whose clients value both his depth of understanding and his ability to achieve results through skilled negotiation and litigation. His practice spans all aspects of family law, including divorce, custody, child support, alimony, modifications, paternity, adoption, asset division, and 209A restraining orders. He also provides strategic pre-divorce planning and drafts pre- and post-nuptial agreements.

Mick’s background includes successful representation of a wide range of clients—from business professionals and owners of closely held companies to law enforcement personnel and homemakers—across matters involving complex asset division, business valuations, inheritance, and domestic violence.

Before joining Ligris, Mick was a partner at Casner & Edwards and previously served as a partner at Burns & Levinson, as well as a senior associate at Mirick O’Connell, where he focused on family, civil, and criminal law. He began his legal career as a clinical intern in the Civil Trial Division of the Massachusetts Attorney General’s Office.

LISA M. CUKIER   is a Partner in the Family Law, Fiduciary Litigation & Services, and Trusts & Estates Groups at Rubin and Rudman LLP in Boston. 12897.bio:
Susan Trotter, Ph.D.,  is a Relationship and Life Coach who helps individuals and couples feel confident, empowered, and deeply fulfilled in their lives and relationships. She specializes in divorce, dating, communication, self-confidence, mindset, and creating healthy, lasting partnerships.

Susan has a particular passion for supporting clients through all phases of divorce. For those contemplating divorce, she provides thoughtful guidance to help them make decisions that are aligned with their values and the well-being of their families. For clients in the midst of the divorce process, she offers both practical and emotional support, helping them navigate this life transition with clarity, confidence, and peace of mind. She also partners with post-divorce clients to intentionally design a new chapter that reflects who they are becoming and the life they truly want to create.

As a divorced mother of one son, Susan has a deep appreciation for the complexities of divorce. She integrates this personal understanding with her clinical training, coaching skills, and deep compassion to provide grounded, insightful, and effective support during one of life’s most complex transitions.

In addition, Susan works with people who want to improve communication, deepen connection, and strengthen their relationships. She is also highly skilled in guiding dating clients through today’s dating landscape, both online and in person, helping them build healthy, meaningful, and lasting relationships.

Susan works with individuals and couples, facilitates groups, and loves to teach. She is a frequent guest on podcasts and other media, has contributed to numerous articles and blogs, and is a sought-after speaker at conferences and events.

Susan began her career as a clinical psychologist and practiced as a therapist for over twenty years. Her extensive background in psychology, therapy, and coaching gives her a unique and powerful perspective, allowing her to help clients create greater joy, satisfaction, and success in their relationships and in all areas of their lives.

13902.bio:
Nina is a CPA and a CDFA™ with over 27 years experience specializing in individual and business tax compliance, tax planning and consultation and divorce financial planning.  Nina absolutely loves her career.  Through her work she is able to combine the biggest parts of her personality: intellectual, logical, technical and compassionate to ultimately help people and to make positive long-term connections.  Her ideal client is one where she can help, guide and empower them to a positive financial outcome.  Nina has worked with many individuals and their divorce attorneys during all stages of divorce including assistance with financial affidavit preparation, asset division analysis and tax implications of various division scenarios, individual tax planning, forensic accounting (income and asset discovery), alimony and child support calculations and post-divorce budgeting.

At age 11 Nina’s parents were divorced and she herself has been divorced for over 8 years.  Her own personal experience with divorce combined with her invaluable professional experience has truly allowed her to help people with her unique sense of compassion, responsiveness and technical knowledge.  Nina graduated Cum Laude with a B.S in Business Administration from Northeastern University in 1992. In 1995 Nina became a Certified Public Accountant.  Later in 2017, Nina obtained the CDFA™ designation and begun officially helping people navigate through all financial aspects of divorce.  Nina has recently joined the Vesta team and is truly looking forward to helping people and the Vesta team with their mission.

Lars has been in the financial services industry since 1992.  He owns Island Time Financial Services, a full-service comprehensive financial planning and wealth management firm.  Lars specializes in holistic divorce financial planning , focusing on making smart decisions in divorce planning, overall financial planning and wealth management.  He is a Certified financial Planner (CFP®) Practitioner.  His other designations include Certified Divorce Financial Analyst (CDFA®), Certified Life Underwriter (CLU®), Certified Long Term Care (CLTC®), Accredited Portfolio Management Advisor (APMA®), Behavior Financial Analyst (BFA®) and Certified Student Loan Professional (CSLP®).  His business mission is to Inspire Confidence, Reduce Stress and Simplify Life for his clients.

Lars experienced divorce as a child, and also went through a contentious divorce after a 16-year marriage.  His goal is to help clients make the emotional, difficult process easier.  Lars is available to represent clients independently or function as a financial neutral for couples.  His divorce financial planning services include:

Guidance, modeling, and expertise with settlement negotiations

Cash flow, income tax and other considerations

Pension valuation

Child support and alimony calculations

Expert testimony

Assistance with creation of financial statements

A father of six, Lars lives in Rehoboth, MA, with his wife and two cats. When he’s not in the office, you’re likely to find him running, watching football, or bingeing Netflix

13896.bio:
Jennifer (Jen) is a mediator and attorney who focuses her practice primarily on non-litigation family law. She has been practicing family law as a mediator and Collaborative Attorney since 2013. In addition to her work with Vesta, Jen is a partner at Skylark Law and Mediation in Southborough, MA. She is also the President Elect (two-year term as President to begin in March 2024) of the Massachusetts Collaborative Law Council (MCLC), a member of the board of the Massachusetts Council of Family Mediators (MCFM),  and a member of the board of the Academy of Professional Mediators (APFM).

In addition to over a decade of experience helping clients navigate conflict around divorce and parenting, Jen is co-parenting her own  children with her former spouse and is a bonus parent to her current spouse’s children. She fully understands the emotional toll that experiencing your own divorce and family changes through your children’s eyes can take. Even in the best of circumstances, where both parents agree that the marriage is over and both parents are committed to being successful co-parents, a support network to help you through the divorce process, your new lifestyle, and solo parenting is a necessity.

Since she first began practicing, Jen has been committed to helping her clients navigate the divorce process in a manner that empowered them to make fully informed decisions regarding their divorce while still preserving important ongoing relationships. Especially when children are involved, marriages end but families do not. Jen will help you and your family not only survive this time in your life, but also to thrive through it.

12974.bio:
Glenn is a Certified Divorce Financial Analyst® (CDFA®) and Life & Health Agent who is also Medicare certified.  He has dedicated a large part of his practice focus to working with clients in all phases of the divorce process. Glenn provides his clients with holistic financial wellness planning and designs plans which take into consideration the division of assets, income analysis, tax diversification and planning for retirement to provide clients with their best financial outcomes in the divorce process.  Glenn’s mission is to give people peace of mind and clarity in knowing “they came to the right place” to navigate the divorce process.

Glenn is dedicated to working with people through the divorce process and experienced it first hand when his parents got divorced after a long marriage.  Even though he was a young adult, it still had a significant effect on him and his siblings. Additionally, Glenn divorced after 24 years of marriage and raising 3 young adults.  He knows first-hand that many people are operating in a mental and emotional “fog” going through this process which can impair one’s judgement. Glenn is dedicated to helping people in this position navigate to clear waters with the wind in their sails.

Over the course of his career, Glenn has excelled at every level.  Before joining the financial services industry 7 years ago, he was a founder of a successful information technology firm with over 500 employees.  Although he was accomplished in business, he derives greater enjoyment from helping people make sense of the world of financial instruments and financial wellness.  He believes discussions are made to be more complex than they really are. He prides himself in being able to talk about finances in a way that can be easily understood by someone who doesn’t live in the world of finance and says “armed with enough, intelligible information, people will make the right decision in their best interest”.

Glenn graduated from Arizona State University with a B.S. in General Business administration.  Of note, he was a member of the 12-0 Fiesta Bowl and Co-National Champion Sun Devil Football team in 1975.  His special skill is connecting with people and lifting them up.

25685.bio:
The process of going through a divorce can be devastating for all parties involved. When you find yourself in the throes of a custody battle, the separation of marital property or deciding spousal or child support, it is easy to become overwhelmed by the convoluted and highly emotional process. Throughout this process it is critical to have an experienced Divorce and Family Law Attorney on your side. Family Law Attorney Ted Khalaf has developed a reputation for being an aggressive advocate of his clients who will not allow them to be taken advantage of by the government or any other party. Among his legal constituents, Ted Khalaf is well respected for his professionalism and ability to do battle on behalf of his valued clients. His expertise in the field of Divorce and Family Law has awarded him the opportunity of speaking at seminars and conventions to other Family Law attorneys about how to strategically handle Family Law cases.

Having gained his expertise and knowledge from a diverse collection of experiences, Mr. Khalaf’s approach to litigation is holistic and draws on a number of different influences. His familiarity with judges and court staff within the local courts has given him an insider’s perspective on the judicial system and a background of relatedness with these key players. His history of maneuvering the local court system in these other capacities brings him an advantage over other litigators and his experience and connections inevitably benefit his clients.

12951.bio:
Kenneth Lee is an attorney specializing in Family Law and is the Principal and Senior Counsel at Schweitzer Law Group.  He earned his Bachelor of Science degree from California State University, Los Angeles and was awarded his Juris Doctor degree from Whittier College School of Law.  He represents clients in all aspects of divorce, from beginning to end, and even after a divorce is over. He advises clients in all divorce related issues, which include child custody and visitation, child support, spousal support, dividing assets and debts.  He further advises clients regarding issues arising after a divorce judgment is entered such as modifying child custody and visitation, modifying child or spousal support or enforcing terms of a divorce judgment.

Kenneth has been practicing law for over 22 years and has handled a variety of cases ranging from criminal law, civil litigation and military law.  He uses his broad experience to help clients navigate and understand the divorce process, as well as assist them in making decisions throughout the process on what is best for them and their particular situation.

In his representation of persons undergoing a divorce, Kenneth has come to realize how frightening and stressful the divorce process can be due to people not understanding the process, what their options are, or what information they need to effectively deal with the divorce process.  Kenneth distinguishes himself by making it a point to ensure that his clients understand all the steps of the divorce process and what information they need to collect so that they are best equipped to deal with the divorce case, bring it to a conclusion, and best set themselves up for success going forward for a new start after the divorce is completed by the court system.

12952.bio:
Zachary Taylor is a mortgage lender with 30 years of experience. Over 25% of his business involves people in some phase of the divorce process.

Zach knows the divorce guidelines, and is able to access programs from his company (CrossCountry Mortgage) as well as programs from dozens of other banks, lenders, and Wall Street investment firms. This allows him to achieve his main goals for his clients: Get them the best rate, and one that fits their situation, that can be approved and that can be closed within the required time-frames.

The division of real estate property in divorce can be challenging to navigate. Contacting Zach as early in the process as possible helps people to have a more seamless experience. He will determine if you can do a buyout or will have to sell.  He will also determine if you can buy a new property based on your “post-divorce” situation using the buyout or sale proceeds. This can save time and prevent unexpected difficulties during the settlement process.

Zach has experience helping people who are going through divorce to better understand and determine the issues involving property and mortgages. Zach shares a common mission with the other professionals in the Carlsbad and San Diego Hub: to provide information and support so that people can feel confident and have peace of mind with the decisions they make in the divorce process. Zach wants to be a valued resource, whether or not a new mortgage is needed, and can also help address issues about credit as well.

Included in Zach’s 30 years of lending experience is a 98% close ratio from 2008 to the present, which happens to be the tightest lending environment ever! He has closed over 2,000 transactions. His background includes underwriting and approving loans. For 16 years, he was Managing Broker and Partner is a successful local mortgage company. He is a licensed California Real Estate Broker and passed the Federal and State Mortgage tests with all background checks required for the NMLS license. He is a graduate of U.C. Laura is a Mediator specializing in divorce, parent planning and other family matters.  She is the founder of Leave Strong Divorce Services located in the Village of Carlsbad, CA.

As a divorce and mediation coach, and co-parenting specialist, Kelly believes that helping you navigate the divorce process through managing your emotions, creating a divorce support team, and finding clarity on wants and needs will enable you to use your divorce to build a strong foundation for your future. Kelly has invested over a thousand hours of training in order to have the expertise needed to support you in having the most successful divorce outcome possible. She believes much of the conflict that occurs during divorce is due to a lack of information. Not having the information needed to make decisions can create a well-spring of emotion that can derail the whole divorce process. Kelly believes her job as a coach is to:

Make sure you understand the realities of the legal system

Help you identify where you have knowledge gaps and direct you to the right professionals to gain the information needed

Assist you in creating your post-divorce goals so you can remain focused on finding a resolution that will allow you to thrive when the divorce is over.

Having gone through her own divorce in 2012, Kelly brings not only a professional understanding of what the divorce process entails, but also a very personal perspective on the individual toll of divorce. Her goal is to create clarity out of the chaos of divorce and make what can be a confusing, frustrating, and often hurtful process more manageable by helping you focus on what you can control.  For things that can’t be controlled, Kelly will assist you in finding your center, staying true to your values, and maintaining your dignity, grace, and integrity in times of high conflict and stress. Kelly will also help you work through the confusion, uncertainty, fear and overwhelm to find the clarity of knowing who you are and what you want out of your next stage in life.

Kelly is proud to be a part of the Vesta network because she strongly believes that the divorce process needs to change. The trauma of divorce not only hurts the individuals divorcing, but also the children and extended families. She believes in helping you build a divorce team that is focused on using their professional skill sets to assist you in making strategic decisions during the divorce process. Kelly also believes it is important to shift the focus of divorce from one that is focused on “winning the battle” to one that is supportive and focused on creating a strong foundation for all parties to thrive post-divorce.

Kelly is a graduate of the University of San Diego, where she also earned her paralegal certificate from USD’s ABA approved paralegal program. She went on to receive her coach training from Coach U, and the Certified Divorce Coach program. In addition to Kelly’s widespread training and experience in coaching, she also earned her Divorce Mediation certificate from Northwestern University and has taken multiple Divorce and Family Mediation trainings with the acclaimed Mosten Guthrie Academy under the tutelage of Forrest (“Woody”) Mosten and Susan Guthrie. 22017.bio:
I learned from my parents’ divorce and my own just how painful and confusing the process can be. I swore that when I became an attorney-mediator, no other family that works with me would experience what I went through. Many years ago, I changed my mediation practice to incorporate co-mediation. Co-mediation involves having two mediators work together as a team. Some of the advantages of this approach include: the mediation team can represent disputants’ diverse characteristics, a disputant has a better chance of feeling a sense of trust with at least one of the two mediators, the disputants have the advantage of the combined expertise of two mediators whose skills enhance and complement each other. I feel privileged to be in the unique position of applying my legal expertise to helping people develop their own solutions. People going through divorce can experience emotionally intense, private, and legally intimidating situations and my hope is to guide them with an effective pathway that leads to the best possible outcome for them and their family.

Judge Prestley is a senior mediator with Connecticut Mediation Center and brings more than three decades of legal, judicial, and dispute resolution experience to her work, helping families navigate divorce and related family law matters with clarity, dignity, and control over their outcomes.

Appointed to the Connecticut Superior Court in 2000, Judge Prestley spent the majority of her judicial career dedicated to family law and served as Presiding Judge in the Family Division. During her time on the bench, she earned the highest ratings from the family law bar and developed deep insight into both the legal and human sides of divorce, custody, and financial disputes. Since retiring from the bench in 2019, she has continued to support families as a mediator and arbitrator in private practice, helping parties reach fair, practical agreements outside of traditional litigation.

Judge Prestley has advanced training in mediation and specializes in divorce, child custody, financial matters, blended-family disputes, and other family-related conflicts. She is known for her calm presence, balanced approach, and ability to foster a respectful, constructive environment where couples can work through difficult decisions and move forward with confidence. Her goal is always to help families find solutions that protect their long term wellbeing and preserve important relationships whenever possible.

Judge Prestley chose to work with Vesta because she believes people deserve access to clear education, trusted professionals, and thoughtful guidance during one of the most challenging transitions of their lives. Throughout her career, she has seen how overwhelming and isolating the divorce process can feel without the right support. Vesta’s mission to provide education, connection, and empowerment aligns deeply with her own commitment to helping families navigate divorce in a more humane and informed way.

Through Vesta, Judge Prestley is part of a highly vetted, multidisciplinary network of legal, financial, emotional, and real estate professionals who work collaboratively to support clients at every stage of the journey. Judge Prestley is proud to be part of a community that believes divorce need not be defined by conflict and fear. With the right education, the right professionals, and the right support, it can be a thoughtful transition into a new chapter.
